summary.text: Shelley Luther is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 62 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Shelley Luther's career experience includes working as a small business owner, operating a horse and animal rescue, and working as a teacher, according to Ballotpedia.
She has served as a member of King's Trail Cowboy Church.
Luther took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Reggie Smith.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Catherine Thorne in the general election.
